mapper.select: SELECT c.cart_id, i.item_id, i.category, i.name, i.description, i.price, i.asset_key, i.asset_url, i.asset_width, i.asset_height, i.placement_type, c.created_at FROM cart c JOIN item i ON i.item_id = c.item_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.cart_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cart ( user_id, item_id, created_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{itemId}, NOW() )
